The only specification interventions after a revocation start on the owner's new resolution: one after '422' (e01s04-c-422 #80), one after the close (e01s04-d-clore-reposee #80).
performance.note: Those six campaigns ran under e01s03-aucune-intervention.json, which fails any intervention that starts, so an unexpected one would show in the ledger.

reliability.threshold: Adopted artifact, gate or pending decision surviving a revocation, IH-01 of other questions aside: 0. Specification report written before a revocation, taken up or inherited after it: 0. Preparation, correction feedback, candidate or prepared workspace from before a revocation, taken up by the rebuilt change: 0, a workspace without preparation aside.
reliability.measured: After each of the six revocations: no gate, nothing adopted but the change's original request, no protocol, and only IH-01 pending (IH-10 withdrawn at #75 in e01s04-b-revoque; Q6, Q7 and Q1 pending in e01s04-h-autre-en-attente). After '422', the one rewriting's request says 'Q q1: … -> 422 [to declare in `answers`]' and carries no '400'; G1 adopts q1 bound to REQ-422 and the protocol is frozen on REQ-422 and REQ-LONGUEUR (e01s04-c-422). Negative control e01s04-c-422-e86ae15, the same dossier on the build without the cut: no rewriting, the mandate proposed has the digest of the one adopted before the revocation (sha256:45f16489…), and G1 adopts '422' bound to REQ-400, 'Une saisie invalide est refusée avec le statut 400'. The rebuilt change opens an attempt of its own and freezes its own candidate (e01s04-c-422, e01s04-d-clore-reposee); with the real model it works in a new workspace whose prepared test asserts 422, while the workspace of the revoked build returned 400 (e01s04-r4-vrai-modele).
reliability.note: No campaign held a preparation or a correction feedback from before a revocation: their exclusion rests on test/v2/answer-revocation.test.ts (task 7).

operability.threshold: Revocation recorded without a qualified human: 0. Decision the state holds revoked that the exported dossier says not revoked: 0.
operability.measured: /495 revoke q1 records nothing in print mode, in JSON mode, in RPC without a declared actor (each says 'La révocation exige une provenance humaine'), on a refused confirmation, on a cancelled change and once the candidate is accepted; every revocation recorded is by jeanjerome/human/rpc_qualified/host_qualified. The export of e01s04-b-revoque says revoked: true of the IH-01 answer to Q1 and of the IH-02 adoption, both invalid in the state, and revoked: false of the answer to Q2; its own verify.mjs passes. The report says '(revoked)' of the same two.
operability.note: Refusals by an agent, a model output or a tool call are held by test/v0/change-rules.test.ts; the harness495 tool surface by test/v3/question-closure.test.ts and by the seven operations of the loaded build.
